description: Superflat Pop is an aesthetic and graphic design style that was prevalent from the late 2000s to early 2010s, inspired by Murakami's established art movement called Superflat . It is characterized by the use of vibrant color palettes, kawaii motifs, and funky clothing. It is often used in animation, video games, advertisements, and fashion. It bears similarities to Y2K Futurism , McBling , Frutiger Aero and Vectordelia , but focuses more on kawaii elements.
